description: Build a layered responsive testing system that validates every route across accurate width/height, touch/hover, orientation, browser-engine, text-scaling, and safe-area conditions; add real Android/iOS device-cloud execution rather than relying on Chrome presets; reconcile prior FRAC-11 browser-gate work; use the suite to validate and repair the homepage hero clipping on Galaxy S24-class short visible viewports; document secrets and physical-device release acceptance.
title: Real-device responsive test system and mobile hero validation
